fault_injection.database_mode: two independent SQLite file connections, journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=FULL
fault_injection.mutation: begin write transactions in both; update both to value=1; COMMIT derived/graph-like DB; force process exit(99) before authoritative/unified-like COMMIT
fault_injection.interpretation: Deterministically demonstrates the known sequential multi-file crash window when the derived file commits before the authoritative file. It does not claim a Frank production crash occurred; it supports fail-closed lineage validation and recovery testing.

connection_hardening_probe.interpretation: The local Python/SQLite build exposes both hardening surfaces. Production compatibility with Frank migrations/schema/extensions is untested and remains an Ubuntu experiment requirement.
